title: English Practice Quiz 0942
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the best word: The road is very ___. There are many cars.
questions.explanation: Crowded means filled with many people or things; it can describe busy roads.

questions.question: ___ I borrow your pen, please?
questions.explanation: May is a polite way to ask permission.

questions.question: You did not hear someone. You say:
questions.explanation: Could you repeat that, please? is a polite request.

questions.question: Read: 'Ravi practises English for twenty minutes every evening.' How long does he practise?
Which question asks for a reason?
The bus is ___ than the car today.
questions.explanation: Use the comparative form faster when comparing two things.

questions.question: He said, 'I am tired.' Reported speech:
options: He said that he was tired.
questions.explanation: In standard backshift, am changes to was after a past reporting verb.

questions.question: She is the ___ student in the class.
questions.explanation: Use the superlative tallest when comparing one with the whole class.

questions.question: I ___ a new notebook yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday signals the past simple. The past form of buy is bought.

questions.question: I think it ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Will plus the base verb can express a future prediction.
